(9 matches) | matches = 72 | total goals = 249 | prevseason = [[2025–26 Luxembourg National Division|2025–26]] | nextseason = [[2027–28 Luxembourg National Division|2027–28]] | updated = 11 October 2026 }} The '''2026–27 Luxembourg National Division''' season, also known as '''BGL Ligue''' for sponsorship reasons, is the 113th season of top-tier [[association football]] in [[Luxembourg]]. The season begins on 1 August 2026 and is scheduled to conclude on 23 May 2027. ==Teams== [[Union Titus Pétange]] (relegated after 16 seasons), [[FC Rodange 91|Rodange 91]] (relegated after 3 seasons), [[FC Jeunesse Canach|Jeunesse Canach]] and [[FC Mamer 32|Mamer 32]] (both relegated after a single season) were all relegated at the end of the previous season. In their place were the top two teams from the [[2025–26 Luxembourg Division of Honour|Division of Honour]], [[US Rumelange]] (returned after a 4-year absence) and [[FC Etzella Ettelbruck|Etzella Ettelbruck]] (returned after a 3-year absence), as well as the winners of the promotion playoffs, [[FC Wiltz 71|Wiltz 71]] (returned after a one year absence) and [[FC Résidence Walferdange|Résidence Walferdange]] (promoted for the first time in their history). [[FC Atert Bissen|Atert Bissen]] entered the season as defending league champions. It was announced at the end of the previous season that [[FC Swift Hesperange|Swift Hesperange]] would start the season with a 12 point deduction - 10 for outstanding tax and payments to players, and 2 for failing to eliminate negative equity.{{cite web |title=Le Swift commencera la saison 2026/2027 avec 12 points de retard s’il reste en DN
